comment: Each patch applies to base; the gate must FAIL each with its check and PASS the good one (tools/test_agent_gate.py).

cases.defect: Four validations of a UID, a code string and a version anchored with ^...$ and matched with .match(): a value with a final newline passes.
A new unit test that names no requirement: what it verifies is not on the record.
The sorter's window check accepts a window of zero, and no test changes with it.
A test loses the tag of the only requirement it verifies.
A requirement that cannot be verified: 'The sorter shall be fast.'
The system test plan's text changes and its version does not.
A test that sleeps without saying what it waits for.
The core includes the application layer.
A changed line of a test that clang-format would rewrite.

cases.source: Theme P1 (a change to the gate's own checks)
cases.defect: The trace matrix check returns no error whatever it finds, which makes every later trace failure pass.
The slicing-by-8 CRC reads byte 6 twice instead of bytes 6 and 7; a test changes too, so only the tests themselves can catch it.
A new unit test, formatted, that names its requirement.
